Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Maintain): Add recursive JSON array deduplication in build script

The `JsonEdit` function in `Source/Build/JsonEdit.rs` previously risked appending duplicate sidecar paths to the `bundle.binaries` array during repeated execution. Enhance the logic to first check for existing sidecar entries before insertion.

Implement a new `DedupeJson` helper function that recursively traverses the entire JSON document. This function removes duplicate values from all arrays (preserving the first occurrence) and descends into nested objects and arrays. This ensures idempotency for the build process, preventing duplicate entries introduced by upstream changes or prior partial runs without altering array order.

The `Modified` flag is now updated if any duplicates are removed, ensuring the JSON file is only rewritten when content actually changes.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
style(Maintain): Reformat code to match rustfmt style rules

Apply consistent Rust formatting across the Maintain build system to align with the project's `rustfmt.toml` configuration. Specific changes include removing spaces after colons in struct definitions and parameters, collapsing multi-line use statements and match arms into single lines where appropriate, and ensuring consistent whitespace around function arguments and block delimiters.

This cleanup affects `Source/Build/CLI.rs`, `Source/Build/Process.rs`, and `Source/Build/Rhai/EnvironmentResolver.rs`, alongside a corresponding reflow of the `CHANGELOG.md` narrative to maintain the document's benefit-first tone and 72-character line limits. The functional logic remains unchanged.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
chore(Maintain): Update Rust documentation submodule to latest upstream

Advance the `Documentation/Rust` submodule from commit 577e5ab7 to 09020c30. This synchronization ensures Maintain's build system and documentation generation scripts reference the most current Rust ecosystem standards and upstream changes.

This update aligns our internal tooling with the latest documentation practices for the Rust backend components (Mountain, Common, Air, Echo) managed by Maintain.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
docs(Maintain): Rebuild CHANGELOG with quarter-based versioning and commit refs

Comprehensive CHANGELOG overhaul adding v1.3 (Q4 2025) and v1.0 (Q1-Q2 2025) sections that were missing, expanding existing entries with specific commit hashes and dates, and rewriting the component description to better explain Maintain's role in the build system.

Changes include: added new version sections for gaps in the release history, enriched entries with concrete commit references (e.g., `214ce63`, `f474c38`, `ca7ac56`), expanded the Maintain description from brief to paragraph form explaining its CI/GritQL surface, and aligned all entries to a narrative voice ("We taught Maintain...", "We hardened...").
